RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up twice at Ayr (1m2f, good to firm) last month, losing out only by a neck when clear of third on latter occasion; back in action before 3lb rise takes effect and remains 2lb lower than when winning this race a year ago; good chance.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
OwnerName: The Hon Heather Galbraith & C Maxwell
Spotlight: Came from off the pace to collar odds-on favourite and cause 25-1 surprise at Ayr (1m, good to firm) 11 days ago; only to due to go up 4lb for that but takes her chance under a 5lb penalty here and remains well handicapped on older form.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up on consecutive starts in Ireland (7f/7.4f) in June but made a low-key stable debut at Ayr (1m2f, good to firm) last month and still has stamina to prove over this sort of trip.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice in June (1m2f/1m4f) and put two poor performances behind him when clear second here (1m5f, good) a week ago; can cope with this drop back in trip and is still on a workable mark; ought to make his presence felt.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive 5yo with modest 1-27 strike-rate; seemed to have benefited from wind op when respectable fifth of 12 at Newcastle (1m, AW) last month but that race was slowly run and he needs to build on that performance; tongue-tie now added.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
OwnerName: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde
Spotlight: Won off basement mark here in June and doubled tally in Ayr classified (also 1m, good) last month; further progress is not out of the question but he has more on his plate today and was soundly beaten in recent Ayr handicap won by Samra Star.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
Spotlight: Weakened into sixth after racing too freely here (1m5f, good; Gemini Man second) a week ago and has now been unplaced all 19 starts (six times over hurdles); drops back in trip with cheekpieces refitted today.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has yet to be placed and was beaten 6l at a big price in a classified event at Newcastle (6f, AW) last Friday; hood worn in her last seven starts is now removed.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Frequent slow starter who was never involved at Redcar last time but he was placed over C&D (good to firm) last month and he won at Catterick (5f, good) in April; has claims if he can get away on terms, and his penultimate win was in this race last year.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
OwnerName: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing
Spotlight: 11-time winner who scored twice last year but he's been generally disappointing in six runs this season; handles most ground but he needs to raise his game to make a serious impact.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Close second in a Hamilton handicap (6f, good to soft) in June but he's not come close to that form in three subsequent runs; overall record is now 1-24 and he needs to rediscover his spark; blinkers worn in last three starts are removed.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
OwnerName: R Chapman, G J Daly & R J Parks
Spotlight: Five-time sprint winner including over C&D; her last success was 13 months ago but she showed signs of a revival when a 2l fifth in a Redcar handicap (6f, good to firm) last week; has possibilities if she can build on that.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Has a better strike-rate on the AW and his last turf win was over two years ago; finished well when runner-up at Catterick (5f, good) in May but he's been quiet since and reared at the start when down the field at Ayr last time; others preferred.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
OwnerName: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner
Spotlight: Just one win from 23 starts but he made a bold bid and was only narrowly denied in a Hamilton handicap (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; has leading claims if he can back that up.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Six-time winner but his last success was in February 2024; ended last year with a close call at Newcastle (5f, AW) but he's been out of sorts since and was last of 14 at Doncaster in April; has plenty to prove and he needs a major revival after a break.

RaceName: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: The last of his five wins was in a classified event at Newcastle (6f, AW) for Ben Haslam in February; made a solid start for new yard when runner-up there (tongue-tie added) in June and he's respected in suitable conditions back on turf.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Hooded for both starts; recovered from slow start to make winning debut at Nottingham (5f, good to soft) in June and followed up at Newcastle (5f, AW) later that month, form that has been very well advertised by the clear second since; has 8lb penalty to carry here but we don't yet know the limit of his ability.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Second foal from 5f/6f winner; no match for odds-on winner when second of four at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago but that was still a promising debut, backed up by a good Topspeed figure; dangerous to ignore.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: In good hands but showed only minor promise on first two starts (6f/5f; both at Hamilton) and has a lot to find with the principals here.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 95,000euros yearling; second foal; half-brother to an Italian 6f/7.5f 2yo winner; dam runner-up 7f 2yo (RPR 79), sister to 7f Listed winner Fadhayyil, half-sister to Listed winners Cold Stare (7f 2yo) and Zipzip (1m2f), out of 5f Group 3 winner; has useful standard to reach on debut.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Built upon encouraging debut when close second at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago, where her tendency to hang left under pressure may have cost her the race; big player on these terms if coping with the drop in trip.

RaceName: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
Spotlight: Doesn't boast a great record round here, has become very hard to win with and the years have looked to be catching up this season; well below market expectations over C&D last time but this is easier again for a yard also responsible for Washington Heir.

RaceName: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
Spotlight: All six wins for Stuart Williams came on the AW and he's never been as good on turf; handicapped accordingly and this is easier again for his new yard but he ran below par in one previous start here.

RaceName: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
OwnerName: T Beeches, C Stone, J Gallagher
Spotlight: Front-runner who's barely put a foot wrong since the blinkers went on; has gone close a couple of times over C&D in the past and is one for the shortlist under experienced 7lb claimer Donagh Murphy.

RaceName: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
Spotlight: 2yo win came over 7f and he's regressed since joining this yard; ran well down to this trip in March (AW) but typically failed to back it up next time and has been off for a few months since.

RaceName: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
Spotlight: Had achieved little prior to springing a surprise in a 0-50 classified event over C&D two months ago; ran to a similar level, back up to 6f, here next time and this is no more competitive back into handicap company.

RaceName: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
Spotlight: Rather lost his way for Michael Attwater and finished a long way behind Dreambird Dolly for his new yard at Salisbury recently; hard to find a reason why he'll turn things round.

RaceName: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden who offered more at Wolverhampton (7.2f) last month before running as well as could have been expected at the weights in a 6f claimer there last Thursday (first-time blinkers; retained); better treated on turf and not out of this.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: £46,000 yearling; first foal; dam 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 93), half-sister to useful 7f-1m2f winner Montather, out of Listed-placed 7f 2yo/1m winner from family of 1,000 Guineas winner Shadayid; yard 26% with 2yos this year and she needs a close look on debut.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: £27,000 breeze-up 2yo; attracted support at big prices on recent Newcastle debut (6f, AW; 16-1) and she came from off the pace to finish a close third of 14; likely player if building on that promising effort and coping with this drop in trip.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Has reached the frame in all four starts and she found improvement when a close second in a Leicester nursery (5f, good to firm) last week; hung right last time but cheekpieces are now added and she should make another bold bid back in a maiden.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up at Nottingham (5f, good to soft) on her second start but she's struggled in her other two runs and was beaten 11l in a small field at Redcar (RPR 40) last time; others preferred

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Made an encouraging start at Redcar in May and she built on that with a front-running third at York (5f, good); just about sets the standard on that form but she flopped at Catterick (last of six) last month and needs to bounce back after that disappointing effort.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promising fifth on Thirsk debut in May and she took a good step forward when a rallying second at Catterick (5f, good to firm) last month; that form puts her in the picture and she's open to more progress; dangerous.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: £50,000 yearling by Harry Angel; finished third of ten on Catterick debut (5f, good to firm; 16-1) last month but she looked awkward under pressure and was beaten almost 6l; should know more this time but she has a lot to find with the principals.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 30,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 1m AW winner Nushafreen (RPR 78); dam once-raced sister to 1m2f winner High Baroque, out of Irish 1,000 Guineas winner and Oaks runner-up Yesterday (sister to Oaks/Irish Oaks runner-up Quarter Moon); has a striking pedigree but she could be one for longer trips later on.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Placed in 6f novice events in two of her four starts including at Thirsk (good to firm) last month; looked stretched when upped to 7f at York last time but has something to prove dropped to 5f and has something to find on the figures; others are more persuasive.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Ran green after a slow start and was never involved when a remote fifth of ten at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month; has a lot to find on this drop in trip and she remains best watched for now.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 18,000euros yearling, £16,000 breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f AW winner Bloodsweatandtyres (RPR 77); dam unraced sister to winners Move In Time (5f Group 1) and Razzmatazz (useful 6f), half-sister to useful 5f winner Meadway; one of two runners for yard and market should guide on debut.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promising fourth at a big price on Beverley debut (5f, good to firm) last month but she didn't live up to market expectations on her return visit eight days later; has bit to prove after that and she needs improvement.

RaceName: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; ran into some trouble when a promising third on recent Beverley debut (5f, good to firm; 11-1) but that form is modest and she needs plenty of progress to make a serious impact here.

RaceName: Copper Blossom Ladies Day Nursery Selling Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten in two 7f novice races since winning run-of-the-mill Brighton maiden (6f, good to firm) on debut in May but has travelled from Oxfordshire for this nursery (trainer's only runner on the card) and can't be written off just yet.

RaceName: Copper Blossom Ladies Day Nursery Selling Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up in both nurseries, more recently when succumbing to Bluestone Lady's late thrust over C&D (good) a week ago; 3lb higher now but still 3lb better off with the winner, and there was nearly 5l back to Amantha in third.

RaceName: Copper Blossom Ladies Day Nursery Selling Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at eighth attempt, keeping on strongly from off the pace to beat Bigalo and Amantha in C&D (good) nursery a week ago; faces tough task under 6lb penalty (only due 4lb rise) but still respected.

RaceName: Copper Blossom Ladies Day Nursery Selling Handicap
Spotlight: Led close home to win C&D seller (good) in June and has made the frame in both subsequent nurseries but was well held in third behind Bluestone Lady and Bigalo here a week ago and may have to settle for another minor role.

RaceName: Copper Blossom Ladies Day Nursery Selling Handicap
Spotlight: Did pretty well to finish third of 12 in Southwell novice (6f, AW) a fortnight ago, given she was drawn wide and did not have a good track position, and has now been placed on two of her three starts; upped in trip for this nursery debut; no surprise if she features.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Portsmouth EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: One of four to come away in a Leicester seller a month ago (third gone in since), when a big price on debut; didn't build on that at Southwell a fortnight ago, behind Enamored, but raced keenly and this is less competitive back on turf.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Portsmouth EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Already-gelded 20,000gns yearling who's the first foal of an unraced mare; has been found the right race on debut for a yard that does well here with 2yos.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Portsmouth EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Trainer 0-55 with 2yos in the past five seasons; started 150-1 for his Kempton debut in June and ran as expected, finishing a remote last of ten.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Portsmouth EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promise at a big price on debut before taking a backward step in a Tapeta novice as favourite last time (main market rival Little Mester behind), having taken a grip; will find this easier.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Portsmouth EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Trainer 0-32 with 2yos this season; it would be a surprise to see this filly get him on the board, having finished well held at a big price on her Chepstow debut a fortnight ago.

RaceName: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improved form upped to 7f when justifying support with a comfortable win in a maiden at Ayr (good to firm; 9-4) last week; this is tougher under a penalty on nursery debut but she's still unexposed and is bred to be useful; respected for in-form yard.

RaceName: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt when making all for an emphatic win in a Musselburgh maiden (7f, good; 11-8 favourite) last Thursday; looks well treated under a penalty for that success and she's open to more progress on this nursery debut; big player.

RaceName: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Remote third of five on Carlisle debut in June but she showed promise when runner-up in a C&D novice (good to firm) last month; should continue to improve with experience but she needs another major step forward to make an impact off this opening mark.

RaceName: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Showed ability in a Chester seller (7f, good to soft) on debut in June but she's struggled in two maidens since; still early days but this looks a tough assignment on nursery debut and others are preferred.

RaceName: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in all five starts including when fifth of eighth on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) last month; dropped 3lb but she needs plenty of progress on this step up to 7f.

RaceName: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden but she's been placed in both nurseries and her latest third was at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; has shaped as though this new trip could suit but this is competitive and she's 6lb out of the weights.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Ran well in defeat on first four starts this season then held on gamely to win 18-runner York handicap (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; effectively 4lb higher here if Jack Nicholls' reduced claim is considered but ought to be right in the thick of things again.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Now 7lb lower than when making all for narrow C&D (soft) win at end of last season but is yet to strike form after five runs this year; needs a good boost from the first-time blinkers.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to his French 2yo Group 3 win and yet to be placed after five British starts this year but ran well before fading into seventh of 18 in recent York handicap won by Jonny Concrete and is another 1lb lower here; one to consider.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who began this season with comfortable wins in Thirsk maiden (7f, good to soft) and Chester novice (7.6f, good); tackles stronger opposition on this handicap debut but needs to be taken very seriously.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Soundly beaten when upped to 1m at Royal Ascot seven weeks ago but is back in much calmer waters here and still has plenty of scope to progress from her winning seasonal/handicap debut at Wetherby (7f, good to firm) in April; shortlisted.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Below form after racing too freely at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good) last week but began this season with two good efforts, the latter a close second at Chester (7.6f, good); could have a say.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 1-7 on AW; ran well before fading into fourth at Wolverhampton (7f) last month, after a break/gelding operation, and remains unexposed over today's trip but needs to find something extra on this turf debut.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice last season and was seemingly back in good form when third at Haydock (7f, good) in May, his second run this year, but two lesser efforts have followed and he now has a point to prove.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner at Ayr (7f, good to firm/good) this year but his recent record is very mixed and he was last of five over that C&D 11 days ago; not easy to predict here and probably doesn't have much margin for error off current mark.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Irish 3yo who won Catterick novice (7f, good) on seasonal/stable debut in May and ran well in two subsequent handicaps over this trip; didn't fire when tried over 1m last month but may still have some potential.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Never really looked dangerous in recent big-field York race won by Jonny Concrete but was in good form beforehand, most notably when winning at Ayr (7f, good to firm) in May; each-way claims at least if back on song.

RaceName: Jenningsbet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Won this last year and a weak 0-50 on Tapeta in March; has never been anything close to consistent but ran respectably, beaten only 2l despite traffic issues, returned to classified level here (1m) on Wednesday.

RaceName: Jenningsbet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Regressive gelding who become inconsistent; punctuated a string of ordinary efforts with a near-miss in a small field over C&D in June (first-time blinkers) but well held the next twice before fading into a modest third over 1m4f here yesterday.

RaceName: Jenningsbet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Still to make the frame after 14 starts (5f-1m); didn't see it out at Chepstow last time, having pulled hard back in the blinkers (removed today), and will need to settle better if he's to see out the longer trip.

RaceName: Jenningsbet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Consistent enough at a similarly low level all year, winning twice, and there are no concerns regarding track, trip or ground; that's enough to see him shortlisted in a weak affair.

RaceName: Jenningsbet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Spent most of his career running over a bit shorter in better company than this; cracked late on his return from an absence, having been gelded, at Salisbury a fortnight ago and is entitled to have come on for that; one to consider.

RaceName: Jenningsbet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Regressive maiden who's been expensive to follow as she's dropped down the levels, including as favourite behind Myna in the winter; will need to improve on previous turf efforts back from six months off.

RaceName: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: In-form 4yo who has won twice over 5f (AW/good to firm) this summer and she didn't get the best of runs when a close fourth of 11 at Chester (5f, good) last time; on same mark here and she should be in the thick of things again.

RaceName: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Better than ever this season, with form figures of 3112, and her latest win was over C&D (good); usually comes from off the pace and she split two rivals who raced more prominently when runner-up here in June; returns after a short break but she's strongly respected off same mark as last time.

RaceName: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap
OwnerName: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde
Spotlight: Won three in a row last season and he's got back on the scoresheet with wins at Ayr (6f) and Beverley (5f, both on good to firm) in his last two starts; has a penalty for his last success but that was a personal best and he's a big player in this hat-trick bid.

RaceName: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Recorded his fifth turf win when scoring at Ripon (5f, good) in May but he's struggled since and has failed to beat a rival in his last three starts; now 3lb lower than for his last success but he needs a big turnaround.

RaceName: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who showed clear promise in novice events but he was beaten 14l on his handicap debut at Carlisle (5f, good to soft) in June; had wind surgery since but he needs to bounce back with tongue-tie added after a short break.

RaceName: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Front-running veteran who has won 11 times including over C&D; got pestered for the lead at Catterick last time but he's been disappointing since his win at Nottingham (5f, good) in April and others are preferred.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap
Spotlight: Not that easy to win with (2-27 on turf) but is a C&D winner (good to soft) and has run creditably when third over C&D on last two starts (closely matched with Montezuma on last week's run); a possible

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap
Spotlight: Won three times last season, all over 5f on good/good to firm; yet to score this term, but creditable third at Thirsk last week (5f, good); a possible.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap
OwnerName: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell
Spotlight: Mainly in good form since winning over C&D in April (good to soft), last week finishing a neck second here (good, hood on for second time; Jer Batt 0.5l back in third); chance.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap
Spotlight: Won a four-runner C&D maiden at 1-6 last July; fair efforts both starts this season; no surprise if he were to run well.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap
Spotlight: Four wins, including over C&D last season; won off 4lb lower over C&D again in April (good) but has finished second five times since, last week going down by a neck in a 6f fillies' handicap at Goodwood (good); 5lb well in; interesting contender.

RaceName: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap
Spotlight: 14-race maiden; second in a C&D novice in 2025, but has raced mainly over further since; beaten over 7l back over 5f at Newmarket last time; bit to prove.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Best results for Ralph Beckett, from whom he was picked up for 35,000gns last autumn (gelded not long after), came on the AW; new trainer 3-7 with runners here but an easy 6f looks a bare minimum, especially after such an absence; market useful.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Comeback success came off 10lb lower and he has to prove this mark within range after another defeat as favourite six weeks ago; having Donagh Murphy take off 7lb is a plus, though.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Made it 2-2 over this trip, having started life in bumpers, off a 3lb lower mark at Leicester in the spring; that came after a three-month break, which bodes well back from four months out, but this is tougher over an easier 6f.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-time Windsor winner, including twice of late, who's having a first run round here; ultra-consistent, especially considering his age and that he's usually dropped in, but there's little room for manoeuvre off this mark; yard also responsible for Duskaura.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Won his maiden over C&D as a 3yo, returning from eight months off, which is a positive after a break of ten months; expensive to follow in handicaps last season, following a second wind op, and it will be interesting to see how he goes in the market.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive of late, despite having had plenty of racing, adding to his C&D win in May (off 9lb lower) when going in at Bath last time (off 3lb lower); there's other pace in here, however, and he'll need another career-best effort.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Back in form at York last time, despite being rather drawn away from the action in a race in which the leaders didn't stop; a while since he went beyond 5f but this may well be run to suit if he gets some luck once dropped in (as seems likely) from stall 9.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Fine effort at a big price at Goodwood last Thursday and will be 3lb higher from tomorrow; has not always been the most consistent and has only gone beyond 5f twice before but will rightly be popular.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Made it 2-3 round Epsom off a 3lb lower mark a month ago and ran to a similar level in defeat last time; might have been better drawn for one happiest on the sharp end but has tended to be reliable once striking form in the past; should go well again.

RaceName: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap
Spotlight: Made all from the rail draw at Lingfield (turf) a fortnight ago; that came in a far less-competitive handicap off 2lb lower against her own sex, and she'll find this rather tougher.

RaceName: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: R A Pegum And Paul Anthony Henry
Spotlight: Won last September on his first two starts for this yard (heavy/AW); disappointing favourite at Newmarket (1m4f, good) on his reappearance but he's been runner-up at Kempton in both starts since; switches back to turf with blinkers now tried; contender.

RaceName: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won the 2022 Cambridgeshire but his only win since came in Bahrain (1m2f, good) last January; came from further back than the winner when runner-up at Windsor (around 1m4f) in June but he failed to beat a rival home over 1m6f at Newmarket last month; drop back in trip should suit.

RaceName: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: AW winner when trained in France but he was mostly disappointing for Joseph O'Brien last year; best effort for this stable came when a 2l sixth of 14 at York (1m, good) in June but he didn't fully prove his stamina for this far when an 11l third there 13 days ago; cheekpieces, worn once previously, are back on.

RaceName: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late John Connolly
Spotlight: Built on his handicap debut with a 7l success at Epsom (1m4f, good) last July; raised 11lb for that success and was well held having raced keenly at Goodwood (1m4f) next time; has been off for 373 days and has the hood applied for his return; watch the market.

RaceName: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Sole win from ten starts came at Angers (1m2f, soft) last September on his final start for Andre Fabre; gelded ahead of his fourth at Chester on his stable debut in May and has ran respectably in both starts since; steps back up to 1m4f with each-way claims.

RaceName: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won his first two starts when trained by Karl Burke; encouraging stable debut at Chester (1m2f, good to soft) in June and was best of the rest behind a handicap blot at Carlisle next time; however, he needs to bounce back from a lesser effort at York (1m4f, good to firm) last month.

RaceName: Brodie Handicap
Spotlight: Much-improved 3yo who made all to beat Much at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) a week ago and now bids to complete quick hat-trick under double penalty; needs to prove he's fully effective on turf but has very obvious claims.

RaceName: Brodie Handicap
Spotlight: Won over a slightly shorter trip here fpr Dianne Sayer a year ago but has not been firing on all cylinders this season; managed only fourth of six here (2m, good) on last week's stable debut; needs to up his game.

RaceName: Brodie Handicap
Spotlight: In the frame three times at Hamilton this year, beaten under 1l when third of five in tactical race on latest occasion four weeks ago (1m5f, good); can go well again here but others look better handicapped.

RaceName: Brodie Handicap
Spotlight: Won four in a row over 1m2f on Polytrack during the winter but absent since midfield finish in valuable 1m4f race on Good Friday; tries another new trip here; not sure to be suited by the return to turf.

RaceName: Brodie Handicap
Spotlight: Belatedly off the mark when making all to score by 7l at Hamilton (1m5f, good to firm) in June, after a break; managed only third of five when odds-on to follow up there last month and needs to kick on again here.

RaceName: Brodie Handicap
Spotlight: Came good with clearcut success at Ffos Las (1m4f, good to soft) in June, her second handicap; below that form after racing too freely on latest outing but remains one to be interested in.

RaceName: Brodie Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who kept on well for clear second behind Roc De Fer on recent handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW): due to go up 3lb for that and is 6lb better off with the winner here; likely contender.

RaceName: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap
Spotlight: Has often pulled hard and has been suited by the drop to 5f lately, taking advantage of a career-low mark when winning at Yarmouth last weekend; picks up a 5lb penalty for that narrow win and will need to settle better back up to 6f.

RaceName: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-time winner for Dylan Cunha, from whom he was picked up for 16,000gns last month having regressed in recent times; fair effort in a first-time tongue-tie for his new yard behind Dragon God on Sunday; chance of turning that round back up to 6f.

RaceName: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive maiden who's with his third yard; ran poorly back from a break when last seen in June and is having just a second start at beyond 5f, so has questions to answer.

RaceName: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap
Spotlight: Landed a second C&D win for Michael Attwater when taking a 0-50 classified event in June; below that level at a short price here a week later and is tried in a first-time tongue-tie for his new yard back into handicap company.

RaceName: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap
OwnerName: J May, R L Field, W Trenchard, J Pook
Spotlight: A long way behind Bated Breeze over C&D a month ago but stronger in the market a week later, when winning a Leicester 0-50; always tended to be hit and miss and be interesting to see how he goes in the betting this time.

RaceName: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap
Spotlight: Can miss the break and/or pull hard but everything panned out when finally winning in a C&D 0-50 classified event a month ago; said to have been suited by being ridden more prominently that day and this no tougher if he can reproduce the effort.

RaceName: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap
Spotlight: Signs of life since handicapping and in latest start he again shaped as though the return to this trip would suit; less exposed than the rest of these and is one to consider.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: In For A Penny Partnership & Partner
Spotlight: Sole win from 11 starts came over 7f at Redcar in May off a mark 10lb lower than today's, but he posted his best effort when going close at Leicester (6f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) last time; can go well.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Won a soft-ground 5f novice last October on her final start for Kevin Philippart De Foy; has posted some respectable efforts for this stable but couldn't get involved over 5f here three weeks ago; down 2lb and has each-way claims stepped up to 6f.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden but he's found only one too good in three of his four starts since joining this stable, including at Ayr (6f, good to firm; lost a shoe) 11 days ago; solid chance.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: Matt Broughton & Hold My Beer Syndicate
Spotlight: Runner-up on her first three starts but she's been well held in three handicaps, including at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in June on her final start for Dylan Cunha; watch the betting on her stable debut.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Placed in one of his seven outings and finished midfield over this C&D in June; disappointed in first-time cheekpieces (now removed) at Ayr (7f, soft) in June and now returns to 6f having been dropped another 3lb.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: D Jenkins J Glover R O'Donnell J Short
Spotlight: Won on his handicap debut at Redcar (6f, good to soft) in September and bounced back from two lesser efforts when third at Ripon (6f, good); below that level having raced freely over 7f last time but should be happier back down in trip.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was sixth of nine on her stable debut and first start for 306 days at Ripon (6f, good) last month; seemed to find the drop back to 5f against her when seventh here two weeks ago and now steps back up in trip off a career-low mark.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; kept on into third of six at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in May but she's been below that level in both starts since, including there last month; others are preferred.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Doubled her tally when winning a classified event at Ayr (7f, soft) in June before a good second there in a handicap next time; did too much too soon and didn't get home over 1m at Leicester two weeks ago, and this free-going sort could go well now dropping back to 6f.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded prior to winning at Newcastle (6f, AW; first start for 82 days) in March and his next two efforts were solid (6f/1m); however, he was well held at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last time after another 82-day break and needs to take a step forward from that.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who has beaten only one rival home in two handicaps (6f/5f; good to firm/AW); this unexposed gelding now steps back up in trip but others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Seven-time AW winner in Britain has struggled for new yard; has pulled up in all three runs over hurdles at huge odds; he would be a shock winner.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner was a good second of 15 on hurdles bow at Downpatrick in September (2m2f, yielding) and would have made the winner work for it if not unseating his rider at the last at Tramore in April (2m, soft); of concern is that the worst of his three hurdle runs came over C&D in October when a 21l sixth of 13 but could go well; well beaten on Flat when last seen.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner is rated 54 on that surface; 0-19 on turf on Flat; makes hurdling bow with a good rider aboard but others more likely.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Sandown 1m handicap winner for William Haggas (1m, good); seems to be improving gradually over hurdles; holds top official rating in the field after taking fourth of 15 at Kilbeggan last time; in the mix.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-6 in point-to-points and heavy defeat in sole start over hurdles at Cork a year ago; similar story likely.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Improved over his debut when making late gains to be beaten 17l into fourth at Ballinrobe in May (2m, good); didn't build on that over C&D last time when tailed off; a few questions arise after that performance.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Kingston Hill half-brother to winners Decision Time (1m4f/1m5f Flat, RPR 86; bumper/2m hurdle), Sergeant Wilson (bumper/2m hurdle) and Stucker Hill (2m5f/2m6f hurdle); dam 7f winner (92); market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-brother to five winners including the useful Farceur Du Large; started the 5-2 favourite and was running respectably on point debut when falling last year; likely best watched unless market speaks.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles; ran to a decent level last year, placing in three maiden hurdles over a range of trips on good ground; similar level when fourth at Listowel in May and shaped better than the bare result at Kilbeggan last month; okay C&D fourth last time; he's solid but vulnerable to improvers.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Decent third in sole completed point start; it was a weak maiden hurdle that he took second in at Sligo (2m2f, good) last time on his third run under rules but it was a positive effort nonetheless; may get involved with claimer now taking off 7lb.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: J J Leckey & Donal P Keane & P J Rothwell
Spotlight: No impact in either point-to-point and beaten 29l on rules debut at Downpatrick; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Never counted in a good-class Leopardstown bumper on debut; well beaten in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time; unlikely.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Didn't trouble the judge in either bumper start; took fourth of 17 on hurdles debut at Clonmel (2m4f, good to yielding) in May; another decent effort over 2m4f here last time when a distant third; thereabouts again.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Weak in the market when down the field at Galway on bumper debut last September; much better at Killarney (2m1f, yielding) the following month when fourth of ten over hurdles; more needed all the same and absence to overcome too.

RaceName: Muirhall Energy Breath Of Fresh Energy Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice over 7f at Catterick in May (good); not at his best last three runs, but stable back in form and interesting with cheekpieces now tried.

RaceName: Muirhall Energy Breath Of Fresh Energy Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins here last summer (7f/1m); bit disappointing this term, but now 3lb lower than last winning mark; stable going well at present; chance.

RaceName: Muirhall Energy Breath Of Fresh Energy Handicap
Spotlight: Won for the fifth time on turf when holding on by a head from Misemerald in a C&D handicap last week (good); not sure to confirm the placings with the second on 4lb worse terms.

RaceName: Muirhall Energy Breath Of Fresh Energy Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win on turf, but was a creditable third to an in-form rival at Newmarket when back from a break last month (7f, good to firm); didn't fare as well over 1m at Yarmouth last week (good to firm).

RaceName: Muirhall Energy Breath Of Fresh Energy Handicap
Spotlight: 2-29 on turf; in the frame on last four starts, last week finishing a head second to Monhammer over C&D; chance of turning the form around on 4lb better terms.

RaceName: Bet Responsibly With Jenningsbet Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Didn't progress in three runs last backend and was beaten some way on his seasonal/handicap debut in June; the drop in trip in first-time blinkers will need to make a difference.

RaceName: Bet Responsibly With Jenningsbet Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Well-related filly who ran below market expectations on her first two handicap starts; better effort on Tapeta last time, when always well positioned, gave some hope and she's one to consider in a weak affair.

RaceName: Bet Responsibly With Jenningsbet Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Won a couple of 0-50 classified events in June, including over C&D, before held under a penalty in a Windsor handicap over further; perhaps that came too soon in a race that didn't pan out her way and she could well bounce back.

RaceName: Bet Responsibly With Jenningsbet Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Regressive gelding who's had plenty of chances, in two forms of headgear; the handicapper's been quick to ease off and the step back up from 6f should help but his best efforts have come on the AW.

RaceName: Bet Responsibly With Jenningsbet Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Three solid efforts here last autumn (closed out with a near-miss over C&D off 7lb higher); generally struggled this season but nothing from this yard can be ruled out currently.

RaceName: Bet Responsibly With Jenningsbet Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Serial slow starter who's still to get involved in a finish; not beaten far last time, again at a huge price, but She Got The Blues is clearly her yard's best chance.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: One of three for yard; AW winner in Britain for Kevin Phillipart De Foy; last seen finishing midfield in a Kempton handicap in May off 81; rider's claim eases welter burden and he'd be conceding much more weight to most of these in a handicap; interesting on stable bow.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
OwnerName: F J Carragher/Yorkavenue Syndicate/Park Ave Syndicate
Spotlight: Form of penultimate neck second in a rated race at Limerick was franked by the winner (to whom he was conceding 6lb) who bolted up off 80 in a handicap at Galway last week; yielding ground not ideal on latest; could bounce back.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Moderate efforts in both starts in maidens; remote fourth at Fairyhouse (7f, good) and down the field at Cork (6f, gd-fm); now drops into claiming company and major improvement required.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Best run in Britain a 1l second in a 7f Kempton novice last autumn; form ordinary otherwise and soundly beaten in a Galway handicap off 73 on debut for this yard last week.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: One of three for yard; shed the maiden tag in a 9.5f handicap here (good) off 59 on his penultimate start; soundly beaten off revised mark at Galway, though trip/ground not ideal there; drawn wide and trip may be on sharp side.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Maiden has finished in the first three in five of her nine runs on turf; narrowly denied in C&D claimer in May; beaten just 0.75l off 62 in a 7f Naas handicap latest; should be on the premises again.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Won four for Richard Hughes (three on turf) at 5.5f-7f; promising start for this yard at Navan in June but never figured when failing to beat a rival back at Navan on latest; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Confirmed promise shown at Dundalk last year when well backed and winning a maiden claimer at Roscommon in May (7.5f, gd-yld); not seen since, which is a slight concern, but should go well if she's ready to rock.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Won a maiden claimer at Roscommon and a 7f Naas handicap last season but has completely lost way since; beaten 18l at Galway on latest; revival needed.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Beaten off 59 in handicaps on last three starts but did win her last start in claiming company at Fairyhouse in May (6f, good); this is a better race and a bit to find on the figures.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Maiden is 0-10 on turf and rated 39; always behind when beating just one rival home at Cork (6f, gd-fm) on latest; steps up to 7f; visor back on but hard to fancy.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: One of three for yard; 3yo showed modest form in four starts for Archie Watson; rating of 60 may flatter him; best watched on first start for new stable after a 73 day break.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: 3yo maiden ran her best race to date over C&D on latest, beaten 1.75l in a handicap off 60; previously finished second at Limerick (6.5f, good) off 57; cheekpieces go on and not dismissed on first try in claiming company.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Course specialist has bagged all three wins here (two over hurdles), including in this race last year off 2lb higher (good to yielding); fairly moderate form after that, but she has returned to form here over fences recently, winning a handicap chase (2m, good) and finishing second last time (2m, good); leading player.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best form has been at Tipperary, where she won a bumper and placed on her handicap debut in October; entitled to come on for recent comeback run at Cork.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best hurdling effort came over C&D early last month when a 4.5l fifth (good), keeping on late in the game; a bit below that in a similar contest last time when a 10.5l fourth (3.25l behind Avandra); improvement required.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Longstanding maiden yet to show anything for current yard (formerly Gordon Elliott); tailed off over C&D back from a break last time; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fair form without winning, in bumpers and maiden hurdles; three handicaps have been less encouraging; tailed off at Clonmel in October; unseated at the first on C&D seasonal return here and tailed off at Kilbeggan last time (2m3f, good); others more likely.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Decent handicap form for new yard; second on stable debut at Sligo in May (2m6f, good), fading late; fourth at Downpatrick (2m6f, good to yielding) later that month; okay fourth at Sligo last time (2m5f, good); drops in trip now but more needed to get home in front.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran one of her best races on stable debut/second handicap start back from a break at Cork (2m4f, good) when keeping on steadily for fourth; always in rear when pulled up at Kilbeggan last time; tongue tie goes on after that disappointment and not ruled out if it has a positive effect.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Outran 80-1 odds at Down Royal (2m2f, good) on handicap debut in May when fourth of 20; a bit below that next time at Listowel (2m5f, good to yielding); midfield finish at Sligo last time (2m5f, good); cheekpieces go on now; place chance.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Little impact in maidens and far too keen when tried in cheekpieces in last month's handicap debut at this track over 3m in cheekpieces (retained); declared for 6.20 at Sligo on Thursday.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed next to nothing in maidens; beaten a long way in both handicaps as well; hard to make a case for her.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Two wins on the Flat but 0-16 over hurdles; good effort when third of 24 at Navan in November (2m, heavy); pulled up next time at Fairyhouse; fell and tailed off in two runs this term so others have more persuasive recent form; declared for 6.20 at Sligo on Thursday.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-21 but some reasons for hope in her runs this season; was a 2l second at Tramore in May (2m, good) and okay efforts at Cork (2m2f, good) when fifth of 23 and when third of ten over C&D last time (good); more needed to win but definite place possibilities.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed just once in seven bumpers; tailed off in all six starts over hurdles, the latest two in handicaps; tongue tie goes on.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Frankel colt who is a sibling to five winners, notably Dream Castle (7f-1m1f including UAE Group 1; RPR 116) and With The Moonlight (1m-1m2f including 2yo/UAE Group 2; 115); dam 5f/6f 2yo scorer (including Group 2; 111); holds two Group entries; yard has won this contest three times this decade; respected.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Teofilo colt who is a sibling to two winners, notably his connections' Oxagon (7f/1m including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 110); dam 6f AW 2yo scorer (75), out of Italian 1m Group 3 winner; one to bear in mind, especially if the market speaks favourably.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 425,000gns yearling; Frankel half-brother to three winners, notably Dramatised (5f including 2yo/Group 2; RPR 113); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo scorer (107), out of half-sister to French 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Aquatinta; has the biggest price tag among the runners who went through the sales ring; one for the shortlist.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 110,000euros yearling; brother to German/French Group-placed 7f-1m4f winner Nasomo (including 2yo; RPR 94); dam 1m2f scorer (including Group 3; 108), closely related to two German 1m4f Group 1 winners; check the betting.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 37,000gns foal, 100,000euros yearling; by Pinatubo; dam French Group-placed 1m2f/1m3f winner (RPR 101), half-sister to useful 7f-1m1f scorer Climate Change, is granddaughter of French 10.5f Listed winner; market may prove best guide.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Colt by Mayson and first foal of unraced half-sister to winners Catan (useful 6f-1m) and Coupe De Champagne (9.4f-1m4f) and daughter of German 1m2f scorer; less interesting than most of his rivals.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Colt by Victor Ludorum out of unraced sibling to winners Raphael (1m) and Roxette (7f); wears tongue-tie; the least appealing contender.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 380,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Kingman and first foal of 7f-1m7f scorer (including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 114) who is half-sister to winners Gallante (1m4f/2m Group 1) and Party House (Group-placed 1m2f); stable is operating at an impressive strike-rate (11-23) with 2yos this season; very interesting.

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Dual Listed winner who made all to win at Windsor on her seasonal debut beating three of these; should improve fitness wise for that run and despite carrying a penalty is clear on the ratings for this; if she runs to form, she'll be very difficult to beat. (R15 W5 P5) (OR 87)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Likeable and consistent Mare who's bounced back to form after a rare poor run at Windsor in Listed company when she was behind three of these; her latest win at Chepstow means she has a penalty to carry and is very badly in at the weights with a few of these but is likely to run her race. (R22 W3 P12) (OR 59)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Was runner up three times in France before bolting up on the dirt on her UAE debut; as only hit the frame once there since on both surfaces mainly over distances further than this; been off since March so others have a fitness edge but will find this a bit easier than some of the races she ran in earlier in the year; market will tell us more. (R17 W1 P5) (OR 75)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Seems at her best when leading; put up a big personal best when finishing to Fareedhat El Izz at Windsor; didn't back that run up in a lesser grade at Lingfield nine days later although that run might have come soon enough; better expected here but has a lot to do at the weights.  (R11 W0 P3) (OR 54)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Has shaped with promise in her three runs to date including when not far behind Victoria over further last time out; was trying to give that rival 18lbs that day so gets a big pull in the weights here, for all the drop down in trip might not be ideal; wears blinkers for the first time. (R3 W0 P3) (OR 60)

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
OwnerName: K Blake/Mrs E Palmer/M Wilson/N Luck
Spotlight: Second runner for yard and the choice of McMonagle; beaten a short head by Rion Rubette in a C&D handicap on yielding in June and 3lb better off with that rival now; not disgraced in Listed race at Galway on latest; majority of best form on easy ground so could probably do with some rain.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Gained back-to-back C&D wins earlier this season, beating Greydreambeliever by a short head in the second one; no impact off revised mark in Curragh premier handicap on latest (8l behind Malavelly); these are calmer waters and could bounce back at her favourite track.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Found just the progressive Meriden too good in a 7f Curragh premier handicap on her latest start in June; another solid run over 1m there on latest; worth another go over this shorter trip and is just 2lb higher than when winning this race last season (run at Tipperary); claims.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have come on soft to heavy ground, including a conditions race over C&D last September; handles quicker conditions but this year's form has not been her best; heavy defeat over 9.5f here on latest; others arrive in better fettle.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark on seasonal return in a Curragh handicap (1m, good), making all in dominant fashion; hit hard for that with a 10lb rise and came up short in premier handicap back at the Curragh on latest (coughing post-race); needs to rebound dropped in trip.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Decent strike rate of 5-22 (three wins here); back-to-back wins at Roscommon (7.5f, gd-yld) and here (9.5f, yld) in May-June; went up 10lb for those two victories but that wasn't the reason why she was pulled up at Down Royal on latest (lost action/scoped dirty); can only be watched after that.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo off the mark at the fourth attempt in maidens at the Curragh (7f,gd-fm) last month; previously a head behind Expert Dancer at Limerick and she ran a cracker in a handicap at Galway off 80 so an opening mark of 79 may be workable; could go well in first handicap.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: 3yo; modest form last year but has run well in defeat in three of four starts this season, including when beaten 1l on handicap debut at Fairyhouse on her penultimate start (7f, good); didn't fire dropped to 6f in first time cheekpieces (discarded) in a Navan maiden last time; not dismissed back up in trip returned to a handicap.

RaceName: Zyn Pole Position EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Improved on debut when winning a six-runner Yarmouth maiden last time (1m2f, good to firm; third has won since), pulling hard but getting the run of the race; obvious contender.

RaceName: Zyn Pole Position EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten in two maidens, last week finishing nearly 10l fifth of eight at Wolverhampton (9.5f; 20-1); more needed.

RaceName: Zyn Pole Position EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: HM The King & HM The Queen
Spotlight: Improved on debut run when 6.5l third to a stable companion of Ancestor in a Newbury novice last month (1m2f, good to soft); further improvement likely over this longer trip on better ground.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Four-time Flat winner is 1-4 hurdling, with the victory coming in a Galway maiden hurdle in 2024; 9.25l fourth of eight over C&D (soft) when last seen over hurdles in March and hasn't been at his best in three Flat runs since then; others preferred.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: French bumper winner has never raced on better than yielding to soft; made the breakthrough for his current stable when taking a six-runner Fairyhouse contest by 12l on handicap debut; came up short off revised mark in Listed handicaps at Fairyhouse and Punchestown towards end of last season; ground a concern for return.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back to form with a good third in a 1m4f Killarney Flat handicap last month but unable to back that up at Ballinrobe five days later; 2-6 hurdling although poor debut handicap effort at Cork when last seen in this discipline.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: P Haughey & P M Haughey & John Ball
Spotlight: Won a Cork novice hurdle (2m2f, good) and a Wexford beginners' (2m, good) last summer; a fall over fences at Wexford is sandwiched between two okay efforts on the Flat this season; a tongue tie goes on for her handicap hurdle debut and she's race-fit but she's on a tough mark.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back-to-back winner at Ballinrobe in August last year at 2m1f/2m3f on good ground, the second of those by 14l; ran respectably in the Lartigue at Listowel (2m, good to yielding) off 1lb higher when last seen in September; appealing but this is his seasonal return.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ready winner of a 2m Cork maiden hurdle in the summer of 2024 (good) but has been absent since well held in a Galway novice a month later; mammoth absence is a major blight on his prospects.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has lost her way until comfortably landing an eight-runner Tramore handicap in May (2m, good); given an easy lead that day and couldn't back it up at Galway when tailed off (2m1f, good); needs things to go her way.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Killarney maiden hurdle by 10l last August (2m1f, good); made all in a 1m1f Flat maiden last month in first-time cheekpieces at Ballinrobe in June; made her handicap hurdle debut at Galway last time (2m1f, good) when posting a disappointing performance; down 1lb but must bounce back.

RaceName: Zyn Pole Position Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Recorded only a modest RPR in finishing seventh of eight at Sandown but perhaps found the minimum trip much too sharp; bred to be suited by this extra 3f and may show improvement.

RaceName: Zyn Pole Position Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus/IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: Cracksman filly who is a sibling to three winners, notably Masai Moon (1m AW 2yo/1m2f turf; 97); dam unraced sister to 1m4f Group 3 scorer Royal Line, out of half-sister to Galileo; one of two newcomers in the field; check the betting.

RaceName: Zyn Pole Position Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 900,000gns yearling; by Starspangledbanner; sibling to three winners, notably Avicenna (7f 2yo including Listed; RPR 105); dam 1m AW 2yo scorer (94), sister to 1m Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner Boherbuoy; powerful stable; interesting debutante.

RaceName: Zyn Pole Position Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Both starts in small fields, finishing last at Wolverhampton (AW) then faring much better with close second at Epsom (7f, good to firm; made the running); sets the form standard and looks open to further progress.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win since joining this yard and not the most consistent but ran a fine race at Galway (7f, yielding) last week when beaten 2l off 75; good ground is fine but needs to back that up now off 1lb higher.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Minor promise in maidens last year; not a bad run at all in Limerick rated race on seasonal return last month, beaten just 3.75l (1.75l behind Alfred Tennyson); 7lb better off with that rival now, should be sharper and eye-catching rider booking for handicap bow; interesting.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner has yet to score on turf but plenty of good runs in defeat including when ahead of a couple of these in a Limerick rated race on penultimate; ground not ideal at Galway latest; place chance back on sounder surface.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Galway in 2025 off 9lb higher and is a two-time C&D winner but yet to find form this season; beaten 13l when down the field at the Curragh latest; needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Scored off 2lb lower at Navan (6f, good) in July last year and went close over 7f (heavy) here in October behind Ribee; never involved on seasonal return at Naas in May (6f, good) and off since; capable off this mark so check the market.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo won his maiden over C&D (good) last August; poor form this term and mark is tumbling but held behind a few of these in Limerick rated race on latest and others look more convincing right now.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time AW winner is just 1-29 on turf but she ran a good race at the Curragh (1m, good) on her penultimate start (beaten 2l, denied clear run); not as good upped to 1m2f latest but drops back in trip now and could go well off 1lb lower than she was at the Curragh.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo; definite potential in a couple of maidens including one here over 1m; didn't quite see out 1m at Naas on latest and now drops back to 7f for her handicap debut and could be on a workable mark; yard in fine form but Foley prefers stablemate.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Won second handicap start in a fillies' event at Fairyhouse (7f, good) in July off 4lb lower under Colin Keane; has come up short twice since, though yielding ground probably not ideal at Galway last time; eased 2lb, cheekpieces go on and Keane returns.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark on turf over 1m here (gd-yld) in May; seemingly anchored by 10lb rise twice since and handicapper slow to relent; a bit to prove off his current mark.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo shed the maiden tag at Fairyhouse (7f, good) in May off 3lb lower; struggled on soft at Leopardstown then didn't get home upped to 8.5f back at Fairyhouse on latest; drop back to 7f looks a big plus and preferred by Foley.

RaceName: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo won a restricted novice at Windsor (6f, good) last year for Eve Johnson Houghton; weakened late on under positive ride on first try over 7f at Dundalk on latest; stamina to prove for this trip.

RaceName: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Ian Williams; first win for current yard with first-time tongue-tie at Epsom last week (1m4f, good to firm), quickening up well after not getting best of runs; could go well with a 4lb penalty although below par two previous runs at 1m6f.

RaceName: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Winner off 4lb lower at Musselburgh in April (1m4f, good) and back to form when runner-up at Chester last time (1m4f, good); seems to stay 1m6f so could go well.

RaceName: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Two good runs when third at York and second at Newbury (both over 10.5f) for today's rider on last two starts; interesting, although stamina not guaranteed on first run at beyond 1m3f.

RaceName: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Set plenty to do in a muddling race for amateurs when third at 8-15 at Catterick on latest Flat start (1m4f, good to firm); bit below-par over hurdles last time; first try at 1m6f.

RaceName: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing
Spotlight: Won a valuable 2m handicap here in August 2024 (good); hasn't won since, but comes into this in good form (second over 2m on last two starts, with cheekpieces back on last time); no cheekpieces here but on a good mark and one with a chance.

RaceName: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo; good bumper performer (two places before 1m5f Fontwell win in March 2025); fair runs at up to 1m4f on the AW on the Flat so far, beaten 10l by Constitution Hill over 1m4f at Kempton in March; chance back up in trip on second handicap start.

RaceName: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins on the AW earlier this year (1m4f); some fair form since, best turf runs being when placed over 1m4f at Beverley; stays 1m6f; a possible.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Ballinrobe handicap by 8l off 10lb lower last July; well beaten in three runs since so best watched for now.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-13 over hurdles but placed six times in maidens; no impact in initial handicap runs but fared better following the application of blinkers in his last two outings; 8l fourth at Limerick (2m7f, good) and 7.5l behind Set The Tone over C&D last time when keeping on well after getting squeezed for room at the third last; not ruled out.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles but chased home a 15l winner in a maiden over 2m4f here in May and faded into third after the last in a 2m5f Bellewstown handicap last month; got to within 4.25l of a 113-rated rival in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time; mark is up 3lb for that, but he's consistent.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: One of his better efforts came over 2m4f (good) here two weeks ago when a 10l seventh of 14; back up in trip now and down 2lb.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Went close at Perth and Galway over this trip last year before disappointing in her opening two runs this year; newly applied blinkers (retained) appeared to spark her back to life over C&D last time when 2.5l behind Set The Tone; 4lb better off with that rival now; chance.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 11yo is 1-27 over hurdles, the win coming at Sligo in August last year off 4lb higher (3m2f, good); okay fifth on seasonal return at Kilbeggan in June (3m1f, good to yielding) but was tailed off at Sligo last time (3m2f, good); others preferred.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 14-race maiden over hurdles; well beaten at Clonmel on seasonal return (2m1f, yielding); some improvement over 2m1f here (good) when a 5.25l eighth of 13; back up to 3m now.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Point winner has raced just four times over hurdles with little success; won a novice handicap chase for Ruth Jefferson at Newcastle in March last year (3m, good); made a positive stable debut over fences at Killarney last time when a 5l second of 15 over fences (2m7f, good to yielding); must bring that form to this sphere off a higher mark.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Got a first hurdles win at Kilbeggan in April last year off 6lb lower (3m1f, yielding); well beaten on return at Punchestown in May and didn't improve at Sligo (3m2f, good) last time; others preferred.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Took a big step forward when second of 18 over an extended 2m6f at Limerick early last month (good); proved that was no fluke when winning over C&D last time (Gerrys Wish 2.25l behind in second); up 6lb but she's of obvious interest.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: No impact in six maiden hurdles and ran poorly on handicap debut at Bellewstown (2m5f, good); unseated at the first over C&D last time; hard to make a case for.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Little to shout about in maidens but ran better race switched to handicaps at Kilbeggan when a 10.5l seventh over this trip; midfield finish at Ballinrobe last time (2m6f, good); down 2lb more and place chance with 7lb claimer back aboard.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled off a shock success at Bellewstown early last month (2m5f, good, 50-1) having pulled up in his previous four starts; moderate effort off 6lb higher over C&D last time.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps in 2024, the first of them was this race off 10lb higher (good) and at Tramore off 17lb higher (2m5f, good to yielding); lost her way badly following that but there were positive signs in her 3l third of 14 over C&D last time, staying on strongly; well handicapped if backing it up.

RaceName: Carling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Holds two Group entries; both starts over 6f on good to firm ground, comfortably landing the odds at Yarmouth then running well (neck second to unbeaten rival) when joint-favourite for Listed event at Newbury; sets a useful standard back down in class.

RaceName: Carling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Holds three Group entries; 325,000euros breeze-up buy who showed signs of greenness en route to justifying favouritism in Nottingham maiden (6f, good to firm), contributing to his yard's excellent strike-rate with 2yos this term; open to progress and warrants respect.

RaceName: Carling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50,000gns foal; by Havana Grey and first foal of unraced half-sister to winners Shifachi (useful HK 6f) and Rosay (1m 2yo Listed) and daughter of 6f 2yo/1m Listed scorer; will need to be a useful newcomer to trouble the main form contenders.

RaceName: Carling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 26,000gns foal, £14,000 yearling, £16,500 (breeze-up) 2yo; Showcasing half-brother to two winners, notably Italica (6f 2yo; RPR 89); dam US 1m turf scorer (including 2yo stakes); faces a demanding assignment on debut.

RaceName: Carling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has recorded only modest RPRs in a couple of 7f events; falls well short of the required standard dropped in distance and is likely to be more interesting in nurseries soon.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 1m1f Ballinrobe maiden in May; responded well to first-time blinkers when fourth two runs ago, so might go well should the visor have a similar effect.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Showed a bit more when eighth of 12 in a 1m maiden at Galway last week; may improve again now moving into handicaps off a modest mark.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced and first start after a gelding operation when running on well to be seventh of 20 over 6f at the Curragh in early May (good); of strong interest raised in distance despite the three-month absence.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: A bit better for cheekpieces over 1m here 13 days ago but again she was uncompetitive, finishing some 11l off the winner in a maiden; handicap debut.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Little in maidens but sprung a 28-1 surprise on handicap debut over C&D two months ago (yielding) when always prominent from a low draw; 7lb higher with Jack Cleary again claiming his 5lb; should feature.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Unfancied and ran accordingly in maidens; 12-1 for handicap debut at Leopardstown (1m, good) but again finished down the field; drawn wide.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Threatened in nurseries last season but not so good this campaign, though had a wide trip last time at Killarney; might endure another here from stall 13.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
OwnerName: Dan Kiely & C O'Neill & Apollo Thoroughbreds
Spotlight: Eight defeats include five handicaps but competitive in two of those (6f/7f) and should have a race in her off this mark; 1m perhaps too far last time.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Little of note in five efforts, four on turf and including a handicap at this sort of trip; opposable.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 but her first run in cheekpieces when beaten 3l over Limerick's extended 6f a month ago and she might build on that.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Started out as a sprinter; signs of finding his level when fourth of 12 last time at Killarney and didn't quite see out the 1m; respected back at 7f.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten 18l+ in three maidens from 7f-1m; all to prove on handicap debut.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has tried a few trips and she's not progressing; now tries new headgear.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice on the AW during the winter; her near 4l third at Killarney (1m, good) last month was her best effort on turf but then fared less well tried in cheekpieces over C&D; bit risky in a new visor.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap
Spotlight: Keeps getting a little closer in handicaps, last time beaten 6l over C&D 13 days ago; down another 3lb.

RaceName: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Created a good impression when winning on his debut at Newbury (6f, good) in May; well beaten in the Coventry Stakes next time but didn't run badly in a Listed event back at Newbury three weeks ago; has since left James Ferguson and drops to 5f for his stable/nursery debut.

RaceName: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up in the Brocklesby on his debut and was beaten only a neck by Adaay Of Scarlett, who has since finished second in a trio of Group 2 events, at Ascot (5f, good to firm); struggled in the Windsor Castle (6f) in June and drops back in trip on his nursery debut having been off since; has claims.

RaceName: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Made all in a maiden at Goodwood (5f, good; runner-up has won since) in June but he raced too freely over 6f in a competitive race there a week ago and was beaten by Undercover Affair in a three-runner contest at Windsor last month ; better is needed but this drop back in trip will suit.

RaceName: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery Handicap
