Spotlight: Two wins from ten starts, with one of those successes coming when beating Jaijai in a three-runner nursery at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last month; didn't prove up to it in the Molecomb last week but should be competitive back into a handicap.

RaceName: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Made a winning debut at Nottingham (5f, good) in April and he was subsequently gelded; off for 108 days before finishing midfield in a Newcastle novice (6f) two weeks ago and now drops back to 5f for his nursery debut; watch the betting.

RaceName: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Bumped into the subsequent Coventry third on his debut at Hamilton (6f, good to soft) in June but failed to build on that at York (6f) next time; however, he ran well when beaten a neck by the subsequent Molecomb third back at Hamilton (5f) last month; commands major respect on his nursery debut.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Showed initial promise in maiden hurdles for Gordon Elliott in 2025; not totally disgraced in the first-time tongue-tie over C&D last month but more needed even in this company.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Poor effort on his handicap debut at Cork in April but much more like it in a pair of 2m1f handicap hurdles here in May; step up in trip is a slight question mark but looks a leading contender.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Had a subsequent triple winner behind her when a remore third in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle in May; cut no ice however on her handicap debut at the same venue the following month and may need to come down a little in the handicap.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Straight into handicap hurdles after a short spell in points; runner-up over this trip in a class 5 at Perth being her best effort; might have had a little too much use made of her at Downpatrick last time; headgear used that day left on here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Has run to a similar level in three maiden hurdles from 2m to 3m on good ground; handicap mark probably fair enough on his handicap debut; best watched.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner and improving over hurdles. culminating in a decent second in a 2m3f Kilbeggan contest two weeks ago; trip is suitable and unlikely to be too far away.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Failed to complete twice since an okay run after a break at Clonmel in May; needs a step forward here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Some promise in a Roscommon maiden hurdle a year ago; pulled up on his second start in a handicap at Limerick in October and not seen since; others much more likely.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Maiden and handicap form does not stack up to very much and easily passed over here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Nothing obvious in three maiden hurdle runs last year; beaten out of sight after more than nine months off on her handicap debut at Kilbeggan last month; cheekpieces fitted here but very difficult to give a chance to.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Won a handicap at Fakenham last October over this trip but hasn't been near that level since including on debut for this yard; has to get back to his best but certainly not dismissed.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: An unknown quantity after three unplaced efforts in 4yo maidens this summer; respected yard, worth a market check on handicap debut in a very winnable contest.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Had a long period on the sidelines but put in a couple of respectable efforts this summer in handicap hurdles at Punchestown and Downpatrick; trip is probably okay for him and good each-way claims.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Fairly lightly raced overall; in very good form this year, winning a handicap hurdle at Clonmel in May and solid efforts since including over 3m here last time; drop back in trip is fine; handicapper has not been harsh on her and the jockey of the moment is booked to ride; ticks a lot of boxes

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 7f; on a two-year losing spell but his turn looks near, having finished second at Ascot (good to firm) the last twice; successful on both Newmarket tracks and the way he races suggests this drop back to 6f is worth exploring; respected.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner on turf for previous yard; absent and had wind/gelding operations since below-par effort on AW last December (stable debut); the market signals may give useful extra guidance on reappearance.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: Solid record at novice level has not been sustained in handicaps; sold out of Clive Cox's yard for £1,000 since last run; may benefit from the drop to sprinting, having been too free in both starts this term.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: Retains plenty of vitality aged nine; record over C&D features wins in this race two years ago and in his last two starts, latest by a neck seven days ago; rock-solid kept to this scenario and likely to remain competitive even with 4lb penalty.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
OwnerName: S Thompson, Mrs R Carr & G Shields
Spotlight: Returns to rather calmer waters after coming up well short in bigger fields at York last month; in particularly good form in June, winning at Pontefract then placed twice over C&D; could go well.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: Close third to Spring Bloom over C&D last week when bidding for a four-timer after wins elsewhere (maiden previously); still on career-high mark but, by the same token, remains in good form; not dismissed.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: On a two-year losing spell and isn't totally solid on 2026 efforts but the latest is best forgiven (got no sort of run; second start for new yard); attractively treated on best form and is a course winner.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: Gained most recent win over C&D last August when with Stuart Williams; however, brings a doubt over current form, having trailed home last (eased once held) in big field at York on stable/seasonal debut.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
OwnerName: John Murphy & Miss L A Perratt
Spotlight: Multiple AW winner; has shown most of his turf form at Ayr, not disgraced last time; 0-22 in this sphere, so the booking of Oisin Murphy (up for first time) needs to make a significant difference.

RaceName: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
Spotlight: By no means certain to give his running, having proved inconsistent for current yard; however, won off 1lb higher on the other Newmarket course in May and has a fighting chance on that form.

RaceName: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed Race) (Registered as the El Gran Senor Stakes)
Spotlight: 260,000euros yearling; 8-1 but knew his job when prevailing narrowly in a bunched finish to a traditionally warm 1m maiden at Killarney last month; nice prospect.

RaceName: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed Race) (Registered as the El Gran Senor Stakes)
Spotlight: Clearcut Bellewstown winner but couldn't repel Venetian Power at Killarney (again over 1m on good) despite dictating matters up front; might do well to reverse those placings and there are others to worry about.

RaceName: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed Race) (Registered as the El Gran Senor Stakes)
OwnerName: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith
Spotlight: Workmanlike on debut when odds-on at the Curragh (6f, good) and again sent off favourite for the Windsor Castle (6f, good to firm) where he lacked the gears to land any sort of blow (third of nine in his group); seemingly held in some regard and could be a different proposition now raised 2f in distance.

RaceName: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed Race) (Registered as the El Gran Senor Stakes)
Spotlight: His debut form gives him a bit to find with City Of Dubai but he stepped up on that effort to narrowly deny Full Volume at Killarney (1m, good); every chance that he'll confirm those placings and go very close.

RaceName: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed Race) (Registered as the El Gran Senor Stakes)
OwnerName: Mrs E Irwin & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Quality pedigree; second to a smart prospect at Leopardstown (7f) and then made all on her return visit (1m, good), denying the well-touted So Lovely who again went close last week at Glorious Goodwood; promising filly and the chosen mount of Dylan Browne McMonagle.

RaceName: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed Race) (Registered as the El Gran Senor Stakes)
Spotlight: Took her five goes to get off the mark but she clocked a good time when making all at Leopardstown (7f, good) and she's clearly progressing; has every chance according to Topspeed/RPR figures.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 8-1, kept on under hands and heels into 3l sixth of 12 on debut in a warm novice at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last month; that was a promising start for this Camelot colt, who should be suited by the step up to 1m; player.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Fourth foal; Too Darn Hot half-brother to connections' 7f 2yo/1m4f Listed winner Novakai; dam 1m4f-1m6f winner (98), half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Elas Ruby; represents powerful 2yo stable and could play a leading role on debut, especially if strong in the betting.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; dam unraced sister to winners Platinum Warrior (US 1m2f Grade 2) and Hadrianus (Listed-placed 1m3f 2yo), out of 1m Group 2 winner; stable has very healthy 25% strike-rate with 2yos in the last five seasons; this Space Blues newcomer is one to be interested in.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 35,000gns yearling; ninth foal; Space Traveller half-brother to winners including San Carlos (7f AW including 2yo; RPR 88) and Signora Camacho (5f/6f 2yo; 83); dam 7f AW 2yo winner (77), half-sister to 5f/5.5f Group 2 winner Signora Caballo; trainer much better known for exploits with older horses.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 250-1 on both starts and has failed to beat a rival each time.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 58,000euros yearling; fifth foal; closely related to 1m AW winner Si Grass (RPR 82), half-brother to winners including Sirona (7f-1m including 2yo/Listed); dam 1m-10.5f winner (including French Group 3); this Australia newcomer could give a good account but a useful standard will be needed.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Seven race maiden but has taken very well to handicaps and acts on most ground; good second on his handicap debut here in March, and another fine effort over this trip with today's headgear when runner-up in a similar contest at Sligo last month; up 2lb for that effort and has plenty of weight but sets a standard that could see him home here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Has shown a reasonable level of form in three maiden hurdle outings; might not be much wiggle room in her handicap mark but interesting on her debut in this sphere.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Showed a little in a maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse in April but well beaten on her handicap debut at Kilbeggan later that month; would not appear well-handicapped on current evidence.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Maiden pointer soundly beaten at huge odds in three maiden hurdles; best watched in first handicap unless money comes for him.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
OwnerName: Anthony Vaughan & Mark Phillips & D P Gaffney
Spotlight: The step up to this trip on good ground might have been the key to a much improved effort when he was runner-up in a Sligo handicap last month; headgear is left on here and could well be on the upgrade.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Landed back-to-back successes over thid trip at Limerick and Sligo before anchored by weight increase at Sligo last month; early to write off and the trainer has decided to claim off her here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Reluctant to race here last month and way too keen on his return here three weeks later; looks far from straightforward and not exactly a betting proposition on what we know so far.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Off the track for two years and caught the eye somewhat when fourth in a 2m1f Ballinrobe handicap hurdle last month; back up in trip here and interesting to see what the market makes of him.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 17-race maiden over hurdles; her Sligo third from last July off 3lb higher would give her a squeak, but well below that level since returning from a break, including over fences; more needed although the rider booking is a positive.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Big odds and ran accordingly in three maidens and handicap hurdle; no obvious chance.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Showed little in maidens or on her handicap debut at Cork; easy to pass over here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Has done most of his winning on the Flat in Britain, and has found a new lease of life over hurdles at his local track last month, following up a good second in a 2m1f handicap hurdle in early July by getting up on the line to land a similar handicap over the same trip three weeks later; up 6lb for those two efforts is far from excessive and he can be thereabouts once more with the step up in trip unlikely to be an issue.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 11-race maiden over hurdles with her best finish being second iver 3m at Punchestown in May off 79;  below par since and drops back in trip here; can certainly get involved at her best.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Ordinary form until a much improved effort in a strongly run contest at Kilbeggan two weeks ago; could be a little more to come from him and rider bookings suggest he is the stable first-string.

RaceName: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent record this term features an AW success; ran respectably, despite a tardy start, on the turf course at Lingfield most recently; remains on career-high mark but has a solid chance.

RaceName: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Probably didn't need to improve to win Redcar novice event (7f, good to firm) last week, opening her account at the ninth attempt; however, has proved largely consistent and should go well.

RaceName: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Raced only four times and may do better still; scored on AW as a 2yo and ran well, with tongue-tie fitted, in Catterick handicap (7f, good to firm) most recently; possibilities off same mark.

RaceName: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Losing run is mounting up but she ran respectably at Carlisle most recently; form over C&D comprises a ready win (off 2lb higher) in this contest two years ago and creditable third (off 7lb higher) last August; good chance back here.

RaceName: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Successful three times over 1m-9.5f on AW this year; failed to transfer the pick of that form back to turf last time; 0-8 in this sphere and has enough to prove dropped back to 7f.

RaceName: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Raced only five times, mostly on AW; scored on handicap debut but failed to back up that form latest start; modest effort in sole turf attempt, albeit on ground that was possibly too soft.

RaceName: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: C Spencer-Herbert, M Herbert & L Bellman
Spotlight: Failed to progress in three starts over 6f last term but showed ability all the same, twice giving the impression this extra furlong will suit on handicap/seasonal debut; market support would heighten interest.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race
Spotlight: Listed winner at two when based in Britain and ran okay on occasions when highly tried as a 3yo; below best in two runs since a gelding operation, the latest here on yard debut; ability respected but current wellbeing is an issue.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race
OwnerName: Richard McNally & Leo Walsh & L Murrin
Spotlight: The highest rated on official figures but has yet to produce a competitive effort this year and he needs a revival, even on these favourable terms; has been starting slowly.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race
Spotlight: Some notable form in 2yo maidens for this yard and went on to perform well in the US; at odds of 1-5 she duly outclassed her rivals in a Killarney maiden last month and interesting that she was engaged in a Group 3 at Leopardstown on Thursday only to be withdrawn.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race
Spotlight: Three good runs since being gelded and the second to Tim Toe at Listowel now reads well; has less to prove than some of these.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race
Spotlight: AW maiden winner; good runs in 7f/1m handicaps at the Curragh this season but finished last there 40 days ago; even if back on song these terms aren't overly generous.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race
Spotlight: Poor hurdler and 200-1 when tailed off in a 1m4f maiden most recently; no appeal.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to four-time Group 1 winner Ombudsman who was sent off at 1-2 when winning by half a length on last month's debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW); the runner-up is now 0-5 but she could have lots more to offer and has a Group 1 entry; very much respected under a 7lb penalty.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Showcasing half-sister to winners Elements Of Fire (7f AW including 2yo; RPR 99) and Forgotten Treasure (7f; 62); dam 7f 2yo winner (97); one to watch in the betting but she's likely to improve for this debut outing.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 48,000gns yearling; ninth foal; Camelot half-sister to five winners notably Nemean Lion (Group-placed 1m4f Flat; smart 1m7f-2m4f hurdle) and No More Bolero (1m2f-2m1f Flat including 2yo, RPR 99; 2m hurdle); dam Listed-placed 1m1f winner (93); she may need further than this debut trip.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Ghaiyyath half-sister to winners Celtic Warrior (7f-1m3f; RPR 88), Gentle Whinny (1m 2yo; 75) and Tearaway Two (Danish 7f/Norwegian 8.7f); dam 5f 2yo winner (80), half-sister to 1m2f 2yo Group 1 winner Wonderment; may be best watched in a useful race on debut.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Her dam was a German Listed winner but she was well beaten at 20-1 on debut at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) three weeks ago and her stable has much stronger claims with previous winner Syndicale.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten 8l when fifth on recent debut at Catterick (7f, good to firm) but this Cheveley Park filly was sent off at just 2-1 and was scuppered by being hampered early; interesting to see if she's again strong in the betting.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Best of the rest behind the 2-7 favourite on debut in five-runner novice at Salisbury last month (6f, good to firm; 13-2); the third has won in fine style since and she's from a family her owner has done very well with; open to improvement and she's a leading contender.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: There's some potential in her pedigree and she could be sharper for last month's seventh of ten on debut at Catterick (7f, good to firm), where she was slowly away at 18-1; however, this is a hotter race and considerable improvement is necessary.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promising third on debut at Salisbury (6f, soft) and short-headed at Newcastle (7f, AW) next time; turned over at odds-on at Lingfield (7f, AW) last time, when a close fourth; some of these probably have greater potential but she might not be far away.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Reappeared from a six month absence when pulled up after racing too keenly in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle two weeks ago; hard to fancy on her return to a bumper.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Decent effort when a fading third in a C&D bumper last month; likely to improve again but this looks somewhat tougher.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Very green on debut at Thurles in October, jumping the road twice and almost coming down; not seen since but sure to be more streetwise this time and is the likely favourite.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Stoutly-bred daughter of Wings Of Eagles; no show in a Kilbeggan bumper in June and hard to give a chance to here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to useful 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Beckett Rock; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, sister to useful bumper/2m4f hurdle winner Column Of Fire, half-sister to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Tully East; fine pedigree and the in-form yard had a debut bumper winner on Tuesday; regular stable amateur riding something else is worth pointing out however.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Shorter trip and much better ground let to a much improved display from this mare when run out of it late in a Killarney bumper last month; tongue-tie tried here and should acquit herself well on a track that should suit.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Clearly fancied on debut at Roscommon last month when having a lot of ground to make up; interesting that John Gleeson takes the mount on her rather than the Knockeen newcomer; big player potentially.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: First foal; dam showed little Flat (RPR 35)/points, closely related to useful French winners Disclose (1m), World Ruler (7f/1m) and Grand Vista (5.5f/6f 2yo); Flat pedigree; hood being applied for her debut not really a positive sign; best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Torquay Road (2m1f/2m2f hurdle) and Omaha Wish (2m chase); dam French 1m-1m4f winner (inc 2yo), half-sister to French 2m5f Listed hurdle winner El Gringo, out of French 1m5f/13.5f winner; useful pedigree; stable does not provide many debut bumper winners but worth watching for future reference; half-sister to today's rival Fully Functional.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Half-sister to today's rival Vartry Diamond; completed on the second of two point-to-points; best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to useful 2m-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Kings Hill; dam unraced half-sister to winners Stick With Bill (useful 2m4f hurdle) and Conceroe (2m4f hurdle/2m5f chase), out of unraced half-sister to smart 2m-2m4f jump winner; stoutly bred daughter of Vadamos; likely to improve for time and a longer trip.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Promise when an admittedly remote second on her debut at Listowel in May; failed to match that when hanging to her left at Cork last month; likely to appreciate going left-handed here but might find a couple too good in a strong-looking race.

RaceName: Aspall Handicap
Spotlight: All five victories have come over a stiff 1m2f so he has that in his favour, including two round Pontefract in June; never won off a mark this high, though, and an 8lb rise for a wide-margin success in an amateurs' handicap last time will test him.

RaceName: Aspall Handicap
Spotlight: Had been looking exposed until upped to this trip (ran right away with a Redcar handicap nine days ago); no penalty for that apprentice-race win and will be fully 9lb higher from tomorrow, so his claims are obvious.

RaceName: Aspall Handicap
Spotlight: Has been running respectably in handicaps against her own age group this summer, without looking to have anything in hand, and is starting to look exposed now; needs to find more against two in-form rivals.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: Useful hurdler but has performed very moderately over fences since November last year and this is a belated return to the Flat with a new visor tried.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: Interesting on last year's promise, placed in 1m3f/1m4f maidens; a bit underwhelming this campaign but still lightly raced and a visor is fitted for handicap debut.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive over hurdles lately and this Flat maiden hasn't run in this sphere for over three years; the cheekpieces are new.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle at Tramore before finishing fifth of 11 runners on return to Flat action back there a month ago (2m); ran okay that day and should be on the scene.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: Some promise in Flat maidens for previous yard and over hurdles for this one; tackles her first handicap here and could be competitive.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: Career wins number five and six last month when prevailing narrowly at Bellewstown (1m6f) and Down Royal (1m5f, good); has another 6lb rise to contend with but he's running well, unlike some in here.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: The last of three Flat wins was three years ago and he's a limited jumper these days at the age of ten.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: Pretty poor in three runs since the 25-1 winner of a 1m4f Tipperary handicap 12 months ago; only 3lb higher if she was all the better for a break.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: 2lb lower than for last summer's win at Cork (1m4f) and wasn't far away 23 days ago at Killarney (second run in tongue-tie); thereabouts.

RaceName: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
Spotlight: 22-race maiden but has placed form in handicaps and a maiden was no good last week; first-time hood.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Very lightly raced 6yo who won a four-runner handicap at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) last month and followed up in three-runner handicap at Lingfield (7.6f, good to firm) last Saturday; carries 5lb penalty in a much deeper race today but he did it comfortably last time; clearly thriving; respected.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: It took him a long time to win but he landed a maiden at Newcastle (6f, AW) in March and was back on the scoresheet at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) last month; good second at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) since; solid claims.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has run some encouraging races in handicaps this year; made good headway before run petered out when fifth of 15 at York (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago and he could benefit from today's drop back in trip and grade; possible player.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Won on turf last April and snapped long losing run at Newcastle (1m, AW) in June; however, well beaten back on turf on his last two starts and he needs to turn things around.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Came from the back of the field to win here (6f, good) last July and she's been a good third on her last two starts (6f, good/good to firm); kept on well at Newbury last time and now has a belated second crack at 7f, which is well worth a go; she's one to consider.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Last of six at Epsom (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago but he's shown glimpses of significant promise in his short career and is worth a second look in view of the excellent form of his stable.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins at Catterick this spring (7f/6f, good); reportedly never travelling when below par there at the end of May and has had a break since; runner-up here in 2024 on sole previous Haydock visit; not ruled out.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Kicked off campaign with two good runs in competitive Class 4 handicaps (6f/7f, good to firm/good) and he capitalised on the drop back in grade to win at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) last month despite hanging badly left; the placed horses have both won since and he's gone up just 1lb; key player.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Two 6f wins at Carlisle this summer (good) and close second of 18 at York (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; this bang-in-form filly could play another leading role.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: Third at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) in May and won there (7f, good to firm) in June; soundly beaten sixth of seven there (7f, good to firm) last time; this lightly raced 4yo is not written off but needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
Spotlight: He's run pretty well in this visor on his last two starts, last time 3l second of 12 at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW); however, he's back up into a 0-75 here and has won just one of his last 29 races; may again be vulnerable.
